```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

library(plotly)
```

loading data

```{r}
data(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb = nyc_airbnb %>%
  mutate(rating = review_scores_location/2) %>%
  select(neighbourhood_group, neighbourhood, rating, price,
         room_type, lat, long) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(rating),
    neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    price %in% 100:500
  )
```

# Plotly

## Scatterplot

```{r}
nyc_airbnb %>%
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Price: $", price, "\nRating: ", rating) %>%
  )
  plot_ly(
    x = ~lat, y = ~long, type = "scatter", mode = "marker",
    color = ~price
  )

```
